expectation: NGFR should be a membrane stain on sparse nerve fibres and Schwann/enteric glial cells, plus some stromal cells and follicular dendritic cells. In gut it should mark thin nerve bundles and plexus and a few lamina propria stromal cells. Epithelium and smooth muscle should stay unstained.
notes: NGFR fills the whole muscle wall as a diffuse haze with vertical streaks. It does not mark discrete nerves or cells, and epithelium and stroma show only faint background. CD21 is saturated everywhere, so row E tests nothing.
observed: A: the right-hand tissue piece is uniformly bright yellow across the muscle, with fibrous streaks and stripes. The other pieces are dim. B and C: no marker-positive cells, only faint haze around the nuclei. D: out-of-focus vertical haze with no cell outlines. E: NGFR is diffuse texture, and CD21 is saturated haze.
why: The signal follows tissue type and fibre texture, with no discrete cells or nerve-like structures, which points to haze or autofluorescence.
